Chart.description: One chart over read-only SQL: timeseries, bar, stat, or table, with title, source caption, Open in Query, and in-chart errors. $1/$2 bind the range as RFC 3339 strings and $3 the bucket.

emits.name: chart.range
emits.description: A time-series brush selected this absolute range for the whole view.

emits.name: chart.open_in_query
emits.description: Open the exact executed SQL and its typed binds in Query.

CardHeader.description: An exact Card version: name, kind, version select, status, uid copy, tabs, and the primary action.

emits.name: card.version
emits.description: Show another exact version of this Card.

emits.name: card.tab
emits.description: Show one of the host-supplied tabs.

emits.name: card.open_in_observe
emits.description: Open this Card's telemetry in Observe.

CardInventory.description: Every registered Card version cards.list returns, in registration order: kind, name, version, status, uid and update time, filtered by kind, lifecycle status, prerelease and a name or metadata query (labels., annotations.), paged by server cursor.

emits.name: cards.filter
emits.description: Read the inventory again under these filters, from its first page.

emits.name: cards.more
emits.description: Show one more page, following the last page's server cursor.

emits.name: card.open
emits.description: Open this exact Card version.

CardFacts.description: An exact Card's server-managed facts (uid, status, hashes, labels, annotations, origin), or the whole returned Card as YAML.

RelationshipList.description: An exact Card's server-derived relationships: each exact outbound and inbound Card reference.

emits.name: card.open
emits.description: Open this exact Card version.

ArtifactTable.description: The files registration recorded for one exact Card version: relative path, size, SHA-256 digest and content type.

PromptMessages.description: An exact Prompt as authored: provider, model and response format, then the portable system text and messages, or the native format's body unchanged.

PromptVariables.description: The text and media variables the server's Prompt compiler derived from an exact Prompt (status.prompt).

UsedBy.description: The Agents whose spec references an exact Prompt, from its server-derived inbound relationships, with each Agent's execution route.

emits.name: card.open
emits.description: Open this exact Card version.

VersionDiff.description: The authored differences between two registered versions of one Prompt: provider, model, system text, messages, settings, response format and derived variables.

emits.name: prompt.compare
emits.description: Compare the Prompt with this other registered version.

VerifierDefinition.description: An exact Verifier as declared: its description, the read-only graph of its inputs, steps, attached and whole-Verifier requirements with their declared dependencies, and the authored declaration of the selected node. No execution state.

RunsOn.description: The Services and Agents whose bindings pin an exact Verifier version, from its server-derived inbound relationships, with each binding's subject and when it runs.

emits.name: card.open
emits.description: Open this exact Card version.

StatStrip.description: One to five recorded numbers with a sparkline each, from built-in reads of bifrost.traces.spans, bifrost.logs.records and bifrost.gateway.calls, optionally scoped to one workload_card_uid or subject_card_uid.

FacetRail.description: Value counts of a signal's columns under the list's own WHERE and range; a value asks the host to filter by it.

emits.name: facet.filter
emits.description: Add this column and value to the WHERE clause; a null value means unset.

RecordTable.description: Typed rows of one signal (traces as root spans with span and error counts, spans, logs or metric points) or of authored SQL, newest first or sorted by a column, paged by keyset cursor, with optional grouping and live mode that pauses while inspected.

emits.name: record.open
emits.description: Open one trace or span, or one log record by its exact identity.

emits.name: record.open_in_query
emits.description: Open the list's exact executed SQL and its typed binds in Query.

emits.name: record.sort
emits.description: Read the list again ordered by this column, from its first page.

emits.name: record.page
emits.description: Read the page after the last row shown, or before the first, in the same order.

TraceWaterfall.description: Every retained span of one exact trace as a timed tree, collapsed below two levels; a span asks the host to select it.

emits.name: trace.select
emits.description: Select this span of the trace.

RecordDetail.description: One exact span or log record: messages, attributes, events, exception and the raw row.

emits.name: record.filter
emits.description: Filter the list by this field, or with not, exclude it.

emits.name: record.logs
emits.description: Show the log records of this span.

emits.name: record.open
emits.description: Open this log record's trace and span.
